description: Escort: Lane Guard: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Four freighters and a thin escort. {enemy} ships will try the lane. Do not let them.
Convoy leaving {system}. Two gunships are with you, the rest is your problem.
{client} needs the cargo delivered. Raiders have been warned of the sailing, so assume they know.
success: All four haulers through. {client} pays {captain} in full.
Convoy delivered. A good day for the freight, a bad one for the raiders.
failure: Too many freighters lost. {client} withholds the fee.
The convoy is broken. Raiders have the lane.
radio-convoy: Four haulers formed. Gate is ahead.
Convoy ready. Keep the line tight.
All freighters accounted for. Move out.
radio-guard: Two gunships on your wing, ordered to hold with the convoy.
Gunships joined. They will cover the freighters.
radio-raiders: Contacts. They are coming for the haulers.
radio-flank: Second group, left. One bomber among them.
Bomber on the left. Kill it first.
radio-last: Two gunships, long range. Do not let them in.
